listenings.text: Hello Rodrigo, nice to meet you in person at last. So, a little about me. I am from Lyon, in France, but I live in Paris now, with my husband and our two children. I work in the global operations team, and I travel a lot, maybe ten times a year. On the weekend I play tennis, and I cook for my family. And you? Where do you live in Brazil? And what do you do on the weekend?

Hi Rodrigo, this is Tom Walsh, from the plant in New Jersey. About Tuesday. The visit starts at ten, and it takes about three hours. Who comes with you? Please send me the names today, for security. A driver picks you up at the hotel at nine. Lunch is at the plant, in our small restaurant. And one question for you: what do you want to see first, the lab or the warehouse? Call me back when you can. Thanks.

extra_audio.text: On Monday Rodrigo read the agenda for the week. At one o'clock he had lunch with Claire, the global director. He asked her about her family and her hometown. She told him about her weekends and her hobby, tennis. At the end they talked about the KPI forum on Wednesday.

reading.rtitle: From: Nora Hayes -- Subject: Your week in New York
paras: Hi Rodrigo, welcome to New York! Here is the agenda for your week with the global team.
MONDAY. Nine o'clock: meeting with the operations team on the twelfth floor. One o'clock: lunch with Claire Martin, our global director. She lives in Paris, but she is here all week.
TUESDAY. Ten o'clock: visit to the plant in New Jersey with Tom Walsh. Tom is the plant manager. He lives near the plant with his family, and his hobby is fishing.
WEDNESDAY. The KPI forum, all day, in the big room. Every region presents for ten minutes. Your turn is at two thirty.
THURSDAY AND FRIDAY. Free for your own meetings. On Friday night we have dinner, just the team. The weekend is free, of course!
A tip: here people talk a lot about the weekend and about their hometown. Ask questions — people love that. See you on Monday! Nora
